our_interpretation: This is a conjunction of three capability predictions about the original GPT-5.
‘Without external aids’ restricts the system being tested; it is not a separate future event that must occur.
Necessary sensors and action interfaces are allowed, but specialist reasoning, planning or driving systems supplying the missing intelligence are excluded.
Beating Cicero means reproducible competitive success, not one lucky game. Reliable driving means sustained safe performance across representative driving conditions.
Rosie is read as broad household versatility. The fictional comparison supplies no measurable task list or reliability threshold.
criteria.support_condition: Representative controlled evaluations establish the predicted limitations in all three domains under the unaided configuration.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A reproducible demonstration establishes at least one of the denied capabilities under the unaided configuration. The other components must be assessed separately.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Controlled tests of the original GPT-5 against Cicero, on representative driving conditions, and on varied household robot tasks, with all external assistance disclosed. A qualifying success could settle a component early.
